end.summary: Om identified standing, sleeping and slanting straight lines, including the slanting edge of a slide, and gave reasons for the examples.
end.parentNote: Asha practised standing, sleeping and slanting lines with Om using familiar objects and letters. Om explained that a slanting line can still be straight; they first mixed up a slight slant or turn with a curved line, then corrected this when discussing the slide’s edge. Straight versus curved lines was practised with easy examples; next time, check this with a why or new-situation question. At home, ask Om to find one standing, one sleeping, one slanting straight, and one curved line, and explain whether each one bends.
